A: a vertex of the given nondegenerate triangle
B: a vertex of the given nondegenerate triangle distinct from A
C: a vertex of the given nondegenerate triangle such that A, B, and C are noncollinear
D: the given point in the interior of segment BC
E: the given point in the interior of segment CA
F: the given point in the interior of segment AB
AD: the straight line through A and D
BE: the straight line through B and E
CF: the straight line through C and F
t: the parameter in (0,1) such that D=(1-t)B+tC
u: the parameter in (0,1) such that E=(1-u)C+uA
v: the parameter in (0,1) such that F=(1-v)A+vB
Q: a variable point used to define affine coordinates
X: the first affine coordinate of a variable point
Y: the second affine coordinate of a variable point
Delta: the positive number 1+x(1+y), written as the Greek capital letter Delta in the proof
P: the unique intersection point of the lines AD and BE
BD: the Euclidean length of segment BD
DC: the Euclidean length of segment DC
CE: the Euclidean length of segment CE
EA: the Euclidean length of segment EA
AF: the Euclidean length of segment AF
FB: the Euclidean length of segment FB
AB: the Euclidean length of segment AB
BC: the Euclidean length of segment BC
CA: the Euclidean length of segment CA
